name: Gasthof Maultasch
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn Maultasch in Grins**

Welcome to **Inn Maultasch**, a cozy mountain retreat nestled in the heart of **Grins**, a charming village in the **Ötztal Valley** of **Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this family-run inn invites you to unwind in the breathtaking Alpine scenery.

Savor authentic **Tiroler** hospitality with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Speckknödel**, and locally sourced game. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Ötztal**, relax by the crackling fireplace with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Schnaps**.

Our rustic rooms, adorned with wooden beams and mountain views, promise a peaceful retreat. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, **Inn Maultasch** offers the perfect escape in the **Tiroler** Alps.
